test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in future tense form.

We were holding the things with a strong rope.

options.text: We will be holding the things with a strong rope.
We have been holding the things with a strong rope.
We were being holding the things with a strong rope.
We are holding the things with a strong rope.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence given *"We were holding the things with a strong rope."* is in the **past continuous tense.**
 
• The equivalent future tense form of this sentence would involve using **"will be"** as the auxiliary verb.
 
• Hence, *"We will be holding the things with a strong rope"* **(Option 1) is the right choice** here.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:- '*We will be holding the things with a strong rope'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2** uses the present perfect continuous tense and thus doesn't fit as the future tense form.
 
• **Option 3** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4** uses the present continuous tense, not the future tense required.
